result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon above the text label, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' all display their respective icons.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon (such as a receipt or shopping bag icon) above the 'Orders' label to maintain visual consistency across the bottom navigation bar.
